findings.remediation: Set `resources.requests` for CPU and memory and a memory limit; a LimitRange can provide namespace defaults.

findings.title: 4 workloads in argocd expose Secrets as environment variables
findings.detail: Environment variables leak into crash dumps, `/proc/<pid>/environ`, child processes and logs more easily than mounted files. Affected: Deployment argocd-redis (REDIS_PASSWORD), Deployment argocd-repo-server (REDIS_PASSWORD), Deployment argocd-server (REDIS_PASSWORD), StatefulSet argocd-application-controller (REDIS_PASSWORD).
findings.remediation: Mount Secrets as files (a `secret` volume) instead of env vars.

findings.title: 7 workloads in argocd have unrestricted egress
findings.detail: argocd-applicationset-controller, argocd-dex-server, argocd-notifications-controller, argocd-redis, argocd-repo-server and 2 more are not selected by any policy that restricts egress, so they can connect anywhere, including the internet and the cloud metadata endpoint.
findings.remediation: Add a default-deny egress policy and allow DNS plus the destinations each workload needs.

findings.title: Gateway legacy-gw accepts traffic on 2 listeners
findings.detail: Listeners: HTTP *:80, HTTPS legacy.example.com:443. No HTTPRoutes are attached.
findings.remediation: Confirm each listener and route is meant to be reachable; restrict `allowedRoutes` to the namespaces that should attach.

findings.title: Gateway demo-gw accepts traffic on 4 listeners
findings.detail: Listeners: HTTP *:80, HTTPS *.example.com:443, HTTP admin.example.com:8080, TCP *:6379. HTTPRoutes web-route, shop, cache-admin, admin-api and 2 more send traffic to StatefulSet redis, Deployment web. Its pods are not protected by any ingress NetworkPolicy, so every port they listen on is reachable.
findings.remediation: Confirm each listener and route is meant to be reachable; restrict `allowedRoutes` to the namespaces that should attach.

findings.title: Ingress web exposes web.demo.local
findings.detail: Routes web.demo.local to services web, backed by Deployment web. Its pods are protected by an ingress NetworkPolicy.
findings.remediation: Confirm these hosts are meant to be public; add authentication at the ingress controller where needed.

findings.title: Ingress web-plain-http exposes web.example.test
findings.detail: Routes web.example.test to services web-public, backed by Deployment web-latest. Its pods are not protected by any ingress NetworkPolicy, so every port they listen on is reachable.
findings.remediation: Confirm these hosts are meant to be public; add authentication at the ingress controller where needed.

findings.title: 1 Role in security-demo is not bound by anything
findings.detail: orphan-exec. Unbound roles grant nothing but clutter RBAC reviews.
findings.remediation: Delete roles that are no longer needed.
